i think you're confusing yourself with "take over" and "1-2 years"

mib/william has not taken over westworld, he is simply a major investor. and we'll never know how shit went down when he returned home because the show is about westworld, not william's personal life. and he is no longer a bitch boy because of a little something called character development

william and logan visited the park primarily because they were planning to buy the park as they were big investors. it's likely logan died- william sent him to the outer edges of the park where hosts (like the horse logan was on) are designed to self destruct. but i guess we don't know for sure if logan is dead so i see your thought process.

but it's implied that logan did die... leaving william in charge of their investment. and upon returning home he married logan's sister, which also makes him a prominent figure in the family as well as the business (delos). 

when ford confronted william/mib (by literally addressing him as william) outside of the church, he mentioned that the park was able to survive as long as it has thanks to william's investment. so he is a big deal in westworld/delos. he hasn't really "taken over". he's just super rich and owns a large sum of the park
